data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): MIGRATION_CLASS and FEATURE_FLAGS are INDEPENDENT markers (separate ticket comments, separate Step 1 helpers). The flag-tag case MUST be an independent conditional that does NOT gate on, reset, or short-circuit the migration-class case — a story that is both migration-class:db AND feature-flags approved must emit BOTH the rollback pair AND the flag pair. The dispatch point evaluates the two markers as separate conditionals, not a mutually-exclusive switch. Verify: grep -qiE 'independent|in addition to|separately|does not (gate|short-circuit)' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
